#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const ll mod = 998244353LL;

ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll res = 1;
    ll b = base % mod;
    ll e = exp;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * b) % mod;
        e >>= 1;
        b = (b * b) % mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    ll k = n * m;
    ll len = r - l + 1;

    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(len, k) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    ll ans = (mod_pow(len, k) + mod_pow(len % 2, k)) % mod;
    ans = ans * mod_pow(2, mod - 2) % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
